description:
Get a Private Endpoint Connection with a given name. 
This is a public API that can be called directly by Notification Hubs users.

operations.description:
Returns a Private Endpoint Connection with a given name. 
This is a public API that can be called directly by Notification Hubs users.

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. E.g. "/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}"
props.name: id

props.description: List of group ids. For Notification Hubs, it always contains a single "namespace" element.
props.name: groupIds

props.description: Represents a Private Endpoint that is connected to Notification Hubs namespace using Private Endpoint Connection.
props.name: privateEndpoint

props.description: ARM resource ID of the Private Endpoint. This may belong to different subscription and resource group than a Notification Hubs namespace.
props.name: id

props.description: State of the Private Link Service connection.
props.name: privateLinkServiceConnectionState

props.description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.
